metric_definitions.formal_delta: np.diff over the continuous formal trace, including midnight; first point missing
metric_definitions.warmup_delta: first formal power minus warmup last power, separate from formal statistics
metric_definitions.nonidle_reversals: opposite consecutive nonzero directions after removing idle; energy tolerance1e-6kWh
metric_definitions.direct_reversals: opposite adjacent nonzero powers, without crossing idle; power tolerance1e-6kW
metric_definitions.episodes: charge starts+discharge starts, each contiguous signed activity run; no merging across idle
metric_definitions.large_jump: |delta power|>1000+1e-6kW, descriptive threshold not an added annual hard constraint
